description: Ministry of Public Administration and Management - Amendment to the Sri Lanka Planning Service Minute published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1670/32 of 10.09.2010
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with revisions to the Sri Lanka Planning Service Minute, which covers public service recruitment, promotions, efficiency bar examinations, and service conditions for planning officers. It focuses on administrative rules and procedures for public sector employees, specifically within the planning service, making it a clear example of Public Service Gazette content (Type 8).
